title: fix(plugin-security)!: a caller whose read of an object is refused is explained the same for every record id, decided by that refusal
body:
Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — a record-grained `security.explain` asked by a principal about its own access, where that principal's read of the object is refused, answers every record id with one explanation: `visible: false`, `decidedBy` the layer that refused the read, singular and batch alike, on every operation; the comment and attachment gates that admit a parent edit on that explanation's `update` verdict follow it.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the published skills do not teach the record-grained explain verdict for a principal without read access.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:主体解释「自己」对某条记录的访问时,若它对该对象的读被拒,`security.explain` 对任何记录 id 都给出同一个解释:`visible: false`,`decidedBy` 指向拒绝读的那一层,单条与批量一致,所有操作一致。
- 为什么改:落实裁决记录 6787890900(#32004):读被拒的调用方对每个 id 得到同一解释,点名读的拒绝及拒绝的层,不区分已存与不存在的记录;第三方询问者保持 #22795 裁决 A 不变。
- 风险与回滚:改 explain 的答案与契约文字;评论门与附件门按调用方自己的 `update` 解释判父记录编辑,因此对「持有编辑、读被拒」的调用方(任何主体类型)改为拒绝,方向为收紧。能读该对象的主体与第三方询问者的答案不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts`(`explainRecordOnPass` 末尾的 refused-read 分支、`ExplainAsker.self`)、`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-explain-access.ts`(`asker.self.readOf`)、`packages/spec/src/security/explain.zod.ts`(契约文字)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/explain-self-refused-read-one-answer.test.ts`,预期全绿,含「the stored id and a missing id get byte-identical explanations, decided by the read's refusal」。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(本 PR 改动已发布的 spec 文件,席位按 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 做契约复核)。

## What changes

The rule (ruling of record 6787890900 on #32004): a caller whose read of an object is refused gets the same explanation for every record id. That explanation names the read refusal and the layer that refused, as its decider, and never tells a stored record from a missing one. A third-party asker keeps ruling A of #22795, unchanged.

- `@objectstack/plugin-security`, explain engine: the internal asker carries `self.readOf` on a self-explanation, the asker's own caller-context by-id read classified three ways (a row, no row, refused) by the existing `readUnlessRefused`. A refused read is "cannot read": the record pass answers the missing record's story, and the decider comes from a read-operation pass of the same record (for `read`, the pass itself), the pattern `attributeThePrincipalsRead` uses. Each per-record attribution is prefaced with the sentence naming the refused read. A read pass that names no refusing layer leaves `decidedBy` out, for every id alike; a store fault in the read fails the explanation, as before.
- `@objectstack/plugin-security`, explain access: a self-explanation is recognised by the request (no other user named), never by the explained context's identity, and is handed `self.readOf`. The other-user arm is unchanged.
- `@objectstack/spec`: the contract text of `ExplainRequest.recordIds`, `ExplainDecision.record` and the record verdict's `decidedBy` states the rule, the decider omitted for every id when no read layer names the refusal, and the carve-out below; the generated references follow.
- The comment gate (`@objectstack/plugin-audit`) and the attachment gate (`@objectstack/service-storage`), where they judge a parent edit by the caller's own `update` explanation of the parent record, admit it only when that explanation is allowed and visible. So they refuse a caller who holds edit on the parent object while its read of that object is refused, whatever kind of principal it is. Neither gate's code changes; both read this explanation.
- The plugin-security engine export `explainAccess(deps, input)`, handed no asker, keeps its signature and keeps answering a refused read by its own read question, as before; the changeset and the spec text state this carve-out.
- Docblocks: `SecurityPlugin#explainAccessForCaller` and `unreadableUnderCallerRead` state the rule.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-self-refused-read-one-answer.test.ts` (new): on a real `SecurityPlugin` over a real `ObjectQL` and SQL driver, two refused-read shapes (create alone; a read capability the object asks that a principal holding every verb lacks, ADR-0066 ⑤), each as a plain, a person and an agent context, every one of the eight operations: the stored id and a missing id get byte-identical explanations, decided by the read's refusal; the batch form likewise. Controls: a principal who reads the object keeps its record story; an asker explaining another user keeps the missing-record answer with no read decider. Engine level: the self read is asked once per record; a refusal no read layer names is one answer with no decider; a store fault fails the explanation for both ids. Parent edit: for a principal holding edit whose read is refused (ADR-0066 ⑤), in each context kind, the `update` explanation is allowed for the object and not visible for the stored row or a missing id, so the predicate the comment and attachment gates read refuses; control: a reader is admitted. No per-gate door pin was added: neither `plugin-audit` nor `service-storage` has a rig with the real security service (it would take new workspace dependencies), so the pin sits on the explanation those gates read.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-asker-gate.test.ts`: the edit-only principal's self-explanation of `read` and `export` now equals the nonexistent id's, decided by `object_crud`; the `update`/`delete` control also asserts whole-explanation equality.
- `packages/rest/src/security-explain-self-refused-read-door.test.ts` (new): the door. `POST` and `GET /security/explain`, every operation, answer the stored id and a missing id with the same body apart from the echoed id, decided by the read's refusal; the batch form likewise; control: a reader is still told the stored row's story.

## Acceptance notes

- The published `explainAccess(deps, input)` has no asker and so no classified read; it asks `deps.recordAbsentToCaller` as before. No door calls it.
- Follow-up (contract review S5): pin that every read refusal a self-explanation answers is a property of the object rather than of a record, or classify the refusal at object level. Not done in this PR.
- The other-user condition in `security-plugin-explain-access.ts` keeps its `request.userId !== undefined` conjunct beside the named constant: it is what narrows `request.userId` to a string inside that arm.
